SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT TO_CHAR(KEY_1) AS LEGACY_PO_NO, TO_CHAR(KEY_2) AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, TO_CHAR(KEY_3) AS LEGACY_GR_NO, TO_CHAR(KEY_4) AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ FROM KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'ILSHGR' ORDER BY KEY_1,KEY_2,KEY_3,KEY_4
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'ILSH' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, nvl(key_1 ,' ') as legacy_po_no, nvl(key_2 ,' ') as legacy_po_seq, decode(nvl(buyer_item_no,'D'),'D','D','C') as status, nvl(buyer_item_no ,' ') as buyer_item_no, nvl(currency_code ,' ') as currency_code, nvl(unit_price , 0) as unit_price, nvl(gr_qty , 0) as gr_qty, nvl(gr_amt , 0) as gr_amt, nvl(gr_date ,' ') as gr_date, nvl(key_3 ,' ') as legacy_gr_no, nvl(key_4 ,' ') as legacy_gr_seq, nvl(dely_to_location ,' ') as DELY_TO_LOCATION, nvl(ro_qty , 0) as RO_QTY, nvl(ro_amt , 0) as RO_AMT FROM keptrxl, view_gr WHERE doc_name = 'ILSHGR' AND key_1 = po_no(+) AND key_2 = po_seq(+) AND key_3 = gr_no(+) AND key_4 = gr_seq(+) AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND KEY_3 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND KEY_4 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_SEQ$' ORDER BY KEY_1,KEY_2,LEGACY_GR_NO,LEGACY_GR_SEQ
DELETE FROM keptrxl WHERE 1=1 AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND KEY_3 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND KEY_4 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_SEQ$' AND DOC_NAME = 'ILSHGR'
